title: Exploring Public Speaking: The Open Educational Resource College Public Speaking Textbook
editor: Dr. Barbara G. Tucker (primary author and editor)
contributors: Amy Burger, Chad Daniel, Jerry Drye, Cathy Hunsicker, Matthew LeHew, Amy Mendes; originated by Dr. Kristin Barton
publisher: Dalton State College / Affordable Learning Georgia

versionNote: References use the page and section numbers of Version 4.1. The textbook website lists Version 4.2 (July 2023) as current; section numbers may differ slightly in that edition.

chapters.title: The Basics of Public Speaking

sections: Understanding the Process of Public Speaking

chapters.title: Audience Analysis and Listening

sections: Sources of Ethical Stances on Communication and Public Speaking
Ethics of Communication, Civil Discourse, and Venues

chapters.focus: General purpose, specific purpose statements, central idea statements, and common problems with each.
sections: Getting Started with Your Topic and Purpose
Problems to Avoid with Specific Purpose and Central Idea Statements

chapters.title: Researching Your Speeches
chapters.focus: Primary and secondary sources, library research, evaluating online information, interviews and surveys.

chapters.focus: Organizational patterns, connective statements, and preparation and speaking outlines.
sections: Why We Need Organization in Speeches

chapters.title: Supporting Your Speech Ideas
chapters.focus: Types of supporting material (definitions, examples, narratives, facts, statistics, testimony) and attention factors.

chapters.title: Introductions and Conclusions
chapters.focus: The five elements of an introduction and the three elements of a conclusion.
sections: General Guidelines for Introductions and Conclusions

chapters.title: Presentation Aids in Speaking
chapters.focus: Functions and types of presentation aids and principles for designing slides.

chapters.title: Language
chapters.focus: Clarity, appropriateness, inclusive language, and rhetorical devices.
sections: Standards for Language in Public Speaking
Developing Your Ability to Use Effective Language in Public Speaking

chapters.title: Delivery
chapters.focus: Methods of delivery, rehearsal, vocal and physical delivery, and advice on the voice.
sections: What to Do When Delivering Your Speech
Expert Advice on the Voice from an Acting Instructor

chapters.title: Informative Speaking
chapters.focus: Types of informative speeches and guidelines for choosing and preparing them.
sections: Guidelines for Selecting an Informative Speech Topic
Guidelines for Preparing an Informative Speech

chapters.title: Persuasive Speaking
chapters.focus: Definition of persuasion, ethos/logos/pathos, propositions, and persuasive organization including Monroe's Motivated Sequence.

chapters.focus: Critical thinking, inductive and deductive reasoning, and common logical fallacies.

chapters.title: Special Occasion Speaking
chapters.focus: Types of special occasion speeches, evocative language, and delivery for ceremonial moments.

chapters.focus: Benefits, challenges, and implications of speaking to culturally diverse audiences.

chapters.focus: Learning strategies, memorization, test and speech anxiety (Part 5), and avoiding plagiarism (Part 7).

chapters.focus: Definitions of key terms.
